title: Durga Puja - Jashn-e Bollywood Live In Bay Area
description: Experience the Extravaganza of Durga Puja - Jashn-e Bollywood Live in Bay Area
long_description:
Experience the Extravaganza of Durga Puja - Jashn-e Bollywood Live in Bay Area
Join us for a magical evening of culture, tradition, and Bollywood entertainment at the Durga Puja - Jashn-e Bollywood Live on the 18th of October, 2026. Organized by Bay Area Prabasi Inc, this event is set to be a mesmerizing mix of Bengali and Hindi live concert performances. Immerse yourself in the richness of Indian culture, right here in the heart of San Jose. Don't miss out on this exclusive experience!
The Artist: A Symphony of Cultural Harmony
While the artist headlining the event is yet to be announced, you can expect a celebrated performer who will encapsulate the spirit of both Bollywood and Bengal. This artist will undoubtedly bring to the stage a unique blend of rhythm, melody, and cultural richness that will leave the audience spellbound. Stay tuned for the big reveal!
Discover the Delight of Santa Clara County Fairgrounds
The event will take place at the Santa Clara County Fairgrounds, located at 344 Tully Rd, San Jose, CA, United States. Known for its safe and accessible location, the venue is a favorite among event-goers. If you plan to arrive early or stay late, you can explore some of the nearby attractions such as the Happy Hollow Park & Zoo and the Japanese Friendship Garden. The venue is also surrounded by a variety of Indian restaurants, perfect for a pre or post-event meal.
Secure Your Tickets for an Unforgettable Evening
Various ticket options are available for the Durga Puja - Jashn-e Bollywood Live. For the ultimate experience, opt for the VVIP ticket with a preferred parking pass priced at $69.00. The VIP tickets are available at $49.00, offering prime seating for the performances. General front tickets are priced at $25.00, and general back tickets at $19.00, ensuring there's an option for every budget. Secure your spot today for an unforgettable cultural experience!
